svg.title: The first workloads on the runtime
svg.desc: Two defensive jobs over synthetic data come first, an access review (built) and then a log investigation (planned), each generated from a seed and graded against an answer key. Under them sit the controls the runtime enforces and the runtime itself, unchanged. The access review exercises neither the target scope nor the approval gate.

g.text: WORKLOADS, SYNTHETIC DATA, GRADED AGAINST A KEY
Target scope, approval before a risky call, a tamper-evident log
Leases, the step log, takeover without a blind repeat
reads files, opens issues; no shell, no target
reads text an attacker could have written
measured against OWASP APTS; no conformance claimed
another worker continues a stopped worker's job from the step log
The access review exercises neither the target scope nor the approval gate; both keep their own tests.
